scientific_integrity: The endpoint uniform density and existence of the stationary law are explicitly credited to Huang--Komornik--Zou. Analytic proof is separate from finite corroboration.
scientific_limitations: Only the absolutely continuous invariant law and its canonical greedy binary digits are classified. Endpoints are understood modulo null sets. Not a higher-order Markov, lazy-map, or other-measure classification. Inaccessible older source full texts leave a priority risk.
title: Exactly two Markov loci for greedy double-base digit dynamics
